# @aria-mcps/aria-mcp-gateway

An [Opencode](https://opencode.ai) plugin that connects to your MCP gateway and lets users browse, enable, and disable MCP servers directly from the Opencode CLI.

On startup it automatically syncs all available servers (as disabled) from the gateway into `opencode.json`. Users then enable the servers they need — they appear under `/mcp` in Opencode.

## What it does

Adds three agent-callable tools to your Opencode session:

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `mcp_gateway_list` | Lists all MCP servers your API key can access, with enabled/disabled status |
| `mcp_gateway_enable` | Enables a server in `opencode.json` |
| `mcp_gateway_disable` | Disables a server in `opencode.json` |

## Installation

### 1. Configure the Artifactory registry for the `@aria-plugins` scope

Add to your project `.npmrc` (or `~/.npmrc` for global):

```
@aria-mcps:registry=https://artifactory.example.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm-local/
//artifactory.example.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm-local/:_authToken=<your-artifactory-token>
```

### 2. Set environment variables

Add to your shell profile (`~/.bashrc`, `~/.zshrc`, etc.):

```bash
export MCP_GATEWAY_URL=https://your-gateway.example.com
export MCP_GATEWAY_API_KEY=gw-xxxx
```

### 3. Add the plugin to your project's `opencode.json`

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@aria-mcps/aria-mcp-gateway"]
}
```

Opencode installs the package automatically via Bun on next startup.

## Usage

Start Opencode — all gateway servers are synced into `opencode.json` as disabled on the first run.

Open `/mcp` in the TUI to see them listed. Then ask the agent to enable what you need:

```
enable the github MCP server
```
```
disable the slack MCP server
```
```
list my available MCP servers
```

## How it works

- **Startup sync** — fetches `GET $MCP_GATEWAY_URL` with `gw-api-key` header, adds any new servers to `opencode.json` with `enabled: false`
- **Enable** — sets `enabled: true` on the entry; visible immediately under `/mcp`
- **Disable** — sets `enabled: false`; user choice survives restarts and is never overwritten by the sync

`opencode.json` entry written per server:

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "github": {
      "type": "remote",
      "url": "https://your-gateway.example.com/mcp/github",
      "headers": { "gw-api-key": "<your_api_key>" },
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Publishing a new version

```bash
# Bump version in package.json, then:
npm run pack
# Upload dist/aria-plugins-aria-mcp-gateway-<version>.tgz to Artifactory
```

## Local development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-org/aria-mcp-gateway
cd aria-mcp-gateway

# Start the mock gateway
cd mock-gateway && node server.js

# In your test project's opencode.json:
# "plugins": ["file:/path/to/aria-mcp-gateway"]
```
